working_tree: Existing local changes preserved; task.patch is relative to task snapshots.
logout_behavior: Session invalidated immediately; native confirmation unmounted; Login route opened without waiting for storage cleanup. Prompt is bound to its session and consumed once.
quotes_behavior: Shared subscription changes reuse transports. Reconnect/unavailable/token rotation preserve last prices and original timestamps with execution disabled; validated new ticks replace them. Broker/account boundaries discard retained prices.

device_validation.reason: Device changed screens during controlled check; screenrecord exited 1. No successful logout/reconnect video is claimed.

build_or_publication: No production build, OTA publication, dependency or native configuration changes.
